about: The deduplication buffer (04-interakcje.md §2.2, COMPLIANCE.md LB-NODE-022…024; zadania/zrobione/BUG-02.md). A command repeated with the same Tid, endpoint and command number within 300 ms of being CARRIED OUT is not carried out again — the node sends the remembered reply. The window counts from the first execution; retries do not stretch it. Every addressed command goes through it, Device ones included. The buffer holds every command of the window, not just eight: the hub counts Tid per endpoint and command, so eight outputs toggled at once and a ninth command right after are all inside one window. Only OK goes into the buffer — not pinned here, because the node never answers BUSY yet and every other refusal repeats itself anyway.

steps.note: the hub's second attempt, 100 ms later: the remembered reply, no second toggle, no report
the third attempt: still the remembered reply
299 ms after it was carried out: still inside the window
300 ms after it was CARRIED OUT — the attempts in between did not stretch the window: a new command, carried out
the same Tid to another endpoint, and another command to the same one: the key is all three, so both are carried out
a key that toggles all eight outputs: eight commands in one go, all with Tid 2, because the hub counts Tid per endpoint and command
a ninth command inside the same window
a retry of the FIRST of the nine: a buffer of only eight entries has pushed it out by now and would toggle endpoint 4 again (04-interakcje.md §2.2)
eight different Tids to the same command within the window: none is taken for a retry
Device commands go through the buffer too: Reboot in 1000 ms
its retry is answered from the buffer and does NOT move the deadline to 3100
restarted when the FIRST Reboot said
